caption: The drawing depicts a single, medium-sized, cylindrical bucket with a rounded base and a curved handle attached to either side near the rim. The surface of the bucket is characterized by diagonal ridges running from the bottom right to the upper left, giving it a textured appearance. The handle is arched and appears to be made of the same material as the bucket, fastened to the bucket with metal loops and rivets. The color of the bucket and handle is a mottled brownish-red, with variations indicating wear or natural material texture. The background is a solid, off-white color, and there are no other objects in the composition. In the bottom right corner, there is a small handwritten signature that reads “ARTHUR S. STEWARD.”
title: Wrought Iron Kettle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
